prompt: Implement an annotation-driven, in-memory HTTP JSON CRUD service in UserController.tnx. Initially no users. POST /users accepts {"name":string}, creates sequential positive ids starting at 1, and returns 201 with {"id":id,"name":name}. GET /users returns an array of users in id order. GET /users/{id} returns 200 and that user. PUT /users/{id} replaces name, returns 200 and updated user. DELETE /users/{id} returns 204 with empty body. Missing ids on GET/PUT/DELETE return 404 with {"error":"not found"}. Deleted ids are never reused. All nonempty bodies have application/json content type. Tests use sequential requests and valid JSON with nonempty names. Preserve Main entry point. Use build-time TINOX_PORT. Only package dependency: tinox.core.http_server 1.0.3.
